svg.text: Reset / boot opening: the plunger that closes it
Plan section through one button. EMC-700 left ±8 kV air discharge NOT RATED here — these are the points
where it RESTARTED, and at 6.0 × 3.0 mm the biggest holes in the case. Both plungers of a half are ONE part.
A — at rest
the spring holds the ears on the shoulder; the pocket is shared
nose 1.5
counterbore 1.4
B — pressed 0.50 mm
0.25 mm of slack for the switch, then its own 0.25 mm of travel
C — elevation, through the wall
the ears stop under the board; the bar drops into a slot along the bottom
the board, on its ledge
D — the pair, from inside
cut apart above, joined by a 1.6 mm-anchored beam below
DIMENSIONAL — it is the gap, and only as good as the print tolerance. Verify with check_btn_plunger.py.
first: 0.25–0.75 mm of plunger travel, not a flat 0.25. ⚠️ Unlike the bonded LED inserts, the protection here is
before the board goes in. The pocket is cut to the furthest-out actuator, so the press runs through up to 0.5 mm of slack
keyboard, one per half, each carrying both of that half’s plungers; fit from the inside,
(SW2/SW3), actuator 1.0 mm proud of its body and landing 0.53 mm outboard of the board edge. TWO parts per
the same modules, so they cannot drift. Switch: Panasonic EVQPUC02K side-push on the board underside
READ from the btn_* parameters in case/case_polykybd_split72_lr.scad — the plunger and the hole come from
13.4 mm flexure rather than a 1.0 mm weld, so pressing one costs ~0.16 N and puts ~0.16 N on the other against the ~2.5 N its switch needs.
The two plungers are cut 1.0 mm apart above the bridge and the bridge touches them only at its two ends, 1.6 mm each: that makes it a
clears it at FULL travel AND at either end of the switch’s own ±0.25 mm placement tolerance — positions a static check never sees.
The part is cut back by travel + 0.25 + 0.12 mm where the switch body is, so the ear plate
the nose does not, because it is in the wall, which carries on above the ledge — and a notch at the top of the nose would widen that gap.
and a corner on each long side. The board rests on a ledge 0.6 mm below the top of the opening, so the ears stop 0.4 mm under its seat;
The only path left is the sliding fit: 0.12 mm per face, 2.2 mm² of slot against 18 mm² of open window, 2.9 mm deep, with a 1.4 mm step
